callees.name: update_llm_settings_toml_text
callees.signature: update_llm_settings_toml_text(text: str, settings: dict[str, str]) -> str
callees.pre_condition: text is a string containing valid TOML content with an [llm] section; settings maps field names under [llm] to their desired string values.
callees.post_condition: Returns TOML content where each field under [llm] named in settings is updated to its corresponding value. All other TOML sections, fields, and comments are preserved unchanged.
